steps.text: Hold your grown-up’s hand at the curb
Look with your grown-up for traffic in every direction
Cross together when your grown-up says it is safe
Step onto the sidewalk together
Sit with your grown-up
Listen to your grown-up say your full name
Say your full name back
Ask your grown-up to check it
Hear the drill alarm
Listen to your teacher
Walk with your class out the safe exit
Go to the outdoor meeting spot
Stay with your class while your teacher counts

sets.goal: Telling a helper your name and address

steps.text: Find a helper with your grown-up during practice
Tell the helper your full name
Say your street number and street name
Say your city
Listen while the helper repeats it back

sets.goal: Crossing at a signal with your grown-up

steps.text: Hold your grown-up’s hand
Stop together at the curb
Wait together for the walk signal
Check together that traffic has stopped, including turning cars
Walk across together while watching traffic
Step onto the far sidewalk
